description: Generic case export: one CSV file with a header row, one case per row. Column names only: this file holds no data. A different export layout means a new mapping version (for example generic_csv_v2.json), not a code change. See docs/data-model.md.

source.timestamps: ISO 8601 with an offset, or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' read as local time in time_zone.

columns.note: The source system's own id. Unique per tenant; the stored id is a UUID, so ids from different tenants never collide.
The first two letters are a city code (RD = Riyadh).
For example Standard case, Police attended, Unlisted.
Values 0 and 1 are valid but unusual and are reported as warnings.
Empty for cases handled remotely. May be earlier than registered_at in some source systems: a data-quality warning, not a validation error.
For remote cases, the end of the review.
Classification rule criterion; kept in the case's extra. Read on new cases only.
Any other value is a warning and the case is imported without a severity.
When present it sets handling (field, or remote as remote_inferred) instead of the assigned-time rule, and is kept in the case's extra.resolution_method.

service_area.note: The bounding box of the sample geography. A point outside is a warning (out_of_range_coordinate); the case keeps it.

derived.rule: ResolutionMethod when present (field, or remote as remote_inferred); otherwise field when assigned_at is present, otherwise remote_inferred

not_in_source_file_note: Fields a basic case export usually lacks. They stay empty for imported cases.

validation.when: a required column is empty, or a required column is missing from the header
a CityID, ZoneID, SubZoneID or CaseTypeID is not in the reference data
Latitude or Longitude is outside its range
a name column differs from its earlier spelling only in capitals
Latitude and Longitude are valid but outside service_area
a point is more than 100 km from its sub-zone centre
Severity or ResolutionMethod is not one of its allowed values
registered more than a day in the future, arrived or closed before registration (impossible times)
arrival more than 24 hours, or closing more than 30 days, after registration (outliers)
a registration day (not the first or last of the file) has more than 3 times, or less than a third of, the median cases per day, with at least 7 days and a median of 10 (a missing or doubled extract)

cleaning_rules.action: The row is not imported; the issue stays listed against the import job.
The first row without errors is imported; later copies are skipped.

cleaning_rules.applies_to: rows with only warnings or notes
cleaning_rules.action: The row is imported unchanged; nothing is guessed or filled in (no imputation).
Imported without that value (null); handling falls back to the assigned-time rule.
Ids are used; names are never joined on, so capitals do not matter.
Read as ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS as local time in time_zone.

One notification per validated import goes to the data owner role (setting imports.data_owner_role, default administrator), critical with errors, warning otherwise; audited as import.quality_escalated.
